startup_contract.start: CreateNewProcTags with ConClip handler entry, priority 0, no console, and no copied variables/current directory
startup_contract.duplicate_guard: The handler's named rendezvous port rejects a second service instance

persistent_services: Open dos.library, iffparse.library, utility.library and intuition.library at version 37 in the worker
Create and delete the named message port ConClip.rendezvous
Install and restore the Intuition string-edit hook
Install and remove the console.device snip hook when console.device opens
Wait on SIGBREAKF_CTRL_C and the rendezvous port, dispatch copy/paste/snip messages, and reply each message
Write and read FORM FTXT/CHRS clipboard data through iffparse.library and clipboard.device
Restore the original CLI module segment and mark the worker segment list for process cleanup
ownership_rules: All message, reply-port, hook, clipboard, IFF, device and library leases are guest-owned and must be balanced on every failure path.
The worker must retain its rendezvous port and hooks only for the service lifetime, then restore the previous edit hook before deleting the port.
OFF is a control operation and must not allocate a second worker or invent a one-shot clipboard implementation.
The source's persistent process and global hook state are incompatible with a transient resident body; lifecycle evidence is required before implementation admission.
source_quirks: The source uses SYSTEM_PRIVATE console AddSnipHook/RemSnipHook APIs.
The source's MorphOS version tag is newer than the selected released source tree; source-to-packed correspondence remains unproven.
